purpose: Outcome grouping + separation guard constructs (task performance is not learning).

separation_title.zh: 结果分离 · 任务表现 ≠ 学习效果

separation_note.zh: 将不同结果类型分开裁决，避免把训练时更快、更高分直接等同于真正学会。
separation_note.en: Outcomes are adjudicated separately so faster training performance is not silently treated as evidence of learning.

method_guard.zh: 任务 vs 学习护栏

guard_principle.zh: 任务表现提升 ≠ 学习效果提升；ADOPT 需要独立学习/保持/迁移证据。
guard_principle.en: Task performance is not learning; ADOPT requires independent learning/retention/transfer evidence.
